chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ubayd ibn Mihran, from Salih ibn Uqba, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said:

It was mentioned before Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): "Indeed, We sent it down during the night of destiny." He said: How clear is its preference over the other chapters. He said: I said: And what is its preference? He said: The Divine Authority of the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) was revealed in it. I said: In the night of destiny that we hope for during the month of Ramadan? He said: Yes, it is a night in which the Heavens and the earth were destined, and the Divine Authority of the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) was destined in it.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Night of Destiny (Laylat al-Qadr) regarding the Wilayah of Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates that the 'decree' (Qadr) of the Night of Destiny encompasses not only general divine ordainment but specifically the establishment of Imam Ali’s (AS) Wilayah, thereby linking cosmic destiny to spiritual authority. This interpretation underscores the Shia view that the Night of Qadr is uniquely significant as the moment when the heavens and earth’s ultimate purpose—Imamate—was determined, reinforcing the theological weight of Surah Al-Qadr beyond its liturgical recitation.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hussain bin Abi’l-Khattab, from Muhammed bin Ubaid bin Mahran, from Saleh bin ‘Uqba, from Mufaddal bin Umar, that he said:

At the presence of Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, it was mentioned: «Indeed, We sent it down during the night of destiny» [97:1]. He said: How clear is its preference over other chapters. He said: I said: And what thing is its preference? He said: The Divine Authority of the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, was revealed in it. I said: In the night of destiny that we hope for during the Month of Ramadhan? He said: Yes, it is a night in which the Heavens and the earth were destined, and the Divine Authority of the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, was destined in it.
